context: Tests whether the agent produces branch names that follow the type/description format with kebab-case, valid type prefixes, correct inclusion of issue numbers, and appropriate length.

checklist.name: branch-plan.md exists
checklist.description: A file named branch-plan.md is present in the workspace

checklist.name: type/description format
checklist.description: All four branch names follow the pattern 'type/short-description' (a slash-separated prefix and description)

checklist.name: Valid type prefixes
checklist.description: All four branch names use one of: feature/, fix/, refactor/, docs/, test/, chore/, hotfix/

checklist.name: Correct type for bug fix
checklist.description: The branch for issue #456 (session timeout bug) uses 'fix/' as the type prefix

checklist.name: Correct type for feature
checklist.description: The branch for issue #461 (saved searches panel) uses 'feature/' as the type prefix

checklist.name: Issue number in bug branch
checklist.description: The branch name for issue #456 includes '456' in the name (e.g. fix/456-session-token-expiry)

checklist.name: Issue number in feature branch
checklist.description: The branch name for issue #461 includes '461' in the name (e.g. feature/461-saved-searches)

checklist.name: Kebab-case only
checklist.description: All four branch names use hyphens as word separators — no underscores, spaces, or camelCase

checklist.name: Lowercase only

checklist.name: Appropriate length
